sections.title: Letters and vowels
sections.note: A few letters at a time, each with a vowel point or two, so you can read real syllables straight away.

sections.title: Drills
sections.note: Practice sets for the tricky parts. They unlock once you have met the letters in them.

groups.title: בּ ב ת  ָ ַ
groups.tip: Hebrew is read right to left. Start with three letters and the vowel a: kamatz  ָ and patach  ַ, written under the letter.

groups.title: א ל מ ם
groups.tip: Mem has two shapes: מ inside a word, ם at the end. Alef is silent: it just carries a vowel.

groups.title: ה ו שׁ  ֹ וֹ
groups.tip: Now the vowel o. With these you can read שָׁלוֹם, shalom.

groups.title: ד י נ ן  ִ ִי
groups.tip: The vowel i is a single dot under the letter, often followed by yod.

groups.title: ר ס ז  ֶ ֵ
groups.tip: Two ways to write e: segol (three dots) and tsere (two dots). They sound the same.

groups.title: כּ כ ך ק  ֻ וּ
groups.tip: כּ with a dot is k; כ without it is kh. ק is also k. The vowel u is usually וּ.

groups.title: ג ח ט ע  ְ
groups.tip: ח sounds like כ (kh), ט like ת (t), and ע is silent like א. Shva  ְ is a short e or nothing.

groups.title: פּ פ ף צ ץ
groups.tip: Two more letters with final forms. פּ with a dot is p, פ without it is f.

groups.title: שׂ  ֲ ֱ ֳ
groups.tip: שׂ (dot on the left) is s. The last vowels are short ones joined to shva.

groups.title: Dot or no dot: בּ/ב כּ/כ פּ/פ
groups.tip: A dot (dagesh) in ב, כ and פ changes the sound: b/v, k/kh, p/f.

groups.title: Final forms: ך ם ן ף ץ
groups.tip: Five letters change shape at the end of a word.

groups.title: Look-alikes: ב כ, ד ר ך
groups.tip: ב has a little tail at the bottom right; כ is rounded. ד has a corner; ר is rounded.

groups.title: Look-alikes: ה ח ת
groups.tip: ה has a gap at the top left; ח is closed; ת has a little foot.

groups.title: Look-alikes: ו ז ן
groups.tip: ו has a small hook; ז a flat cap; ן drops below the line.

groups.title: Look-alikes: ס ם, ע צ, ג נ, ט מ
groups.tip: ס is round, ם is square. ע has two arms meeting at the bottom; צ has a flat base.
